note: DEC-0016 to DEC-0019 approved by User on 2026-10-03 as part of the P3 approval.

decisions.title: Production registry is populated only through the promotion gate
decisions.decision: Capabilities enter sps2/capability/registry.json only if engine.promote() returns ok; every rejection reason is recorded.
decisions.reason: Emptiness was a valid P1 and P2 state, but the real invariant is that a registered capability is evidenced, not that the registry is empty.

alternatives.option: Keep the registry permanently empty until a later phase
alternatives.rejected_because: P3 exists to establish the mechanism; an empty registry would prove nothing.

approval.basis: Explicit user approval of P3, including the documented security incident closure, 2026-10-03

decisions.title: Ranking factors are evidence-weighted; popularity is a tie-breaker only
decisions.decision: Requirement fit 30, compatibility 20, security 20, licence 10, freshness 8, maintenance 5, provenance confidence 5, verification 2. Popularity and recency never contribute points.
decisions.reason: A weight that admits stars would let reputation outrank evidence, which the P1 and P2 principles forbid.

alternatives.option: Include popularity as a ranking factor
alternatives.rejected_because: Popularity is contextual evidence only, per the P2 source hierarchy.

approval.basis: Explicit user approval of P3, including the documented security incident closure, 2026-10-03

decisions.title: A forced user choice is honoured but cannot override mandatory safety
decisions.decision: apply_forced_choice promotes the chosen capability to rank 1 unless its security status is VULNERABLE or SUSPECTED_RISK, its scope is unauthorised GLOBAL, or its lifecycle is REJECTED or REMOVED.
decisions.reason: Respecting the user and protecting the user are both required: a silent substitution would be a lie, and blind obedience would be unsafe.

alternatives.rejected_because: That would silently override an explicit user decision.
That would let a forced choice bypass a safety constraint.

approval.basis: Explicit user approval of P3, including the documented security incident closure, 2026-10-03

decisions.title: Provenance is declared static, never runtime
decisions.decision: The selection record sets provenance.method to static and runtime_tracing to false, and the gate requires an origin, a hex commit and a fact class.
decisions.reason: P3 does not implement runtime provenance tracing and must not imply that it does.

alternatives.rejected_because: No runtime tracing exists, so the claim would be false.

approval.basis: Explicit user approval of P3, including the documented security incident closure, 2026-10-03
